summary.text: Charlane Oliver is a Democratic state senator from Nashville who represents Tennessee Senate District 19 in part of Davidson County and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
She is a nonprofit executive who serves on the Senate Energy, Agriculture and Natural Resources and Government Operations committees.

paragraphs.text: Charlane Oliver is married with three children, according to the Tennessee General Assembly.
She earned a B.S. from Vanderbilt University in 2005 and a Master of Public Administration from the University of Tennessee at Knoxville in 2008.
Her legislative biography lists her profession as nonprofit executive.
Oliver has been a member of the Senate for the 113th and 114th General Assemblies.
Her listed affiliations include Leadership Nashville, the NAACP Nashville branch, The Equity Alliance, and the boards of Nurture The Next and Stand Up Nashville.
